text: dsh-skin-kit 是面向 DSH 网页端的皮肤工具箱，通过宿主插件路由和客户端设置面板接入界面。它提供十套内置壁纸主题，可即时切换并调节面板透明度、壁纸模糊和亮度；也能把自己的图片或视频生成皮肤，并导入、导出皮肤包。适合想个性化 DSH 外观或制作、分享壁纸主题的用户。需要 Node.js 18.17 或更高版本；ffmpeg 可选，用于素材取色和部分格式处理。

dsh-skin-kit themes the DSH web UI with ten wallpaper skins. Switch themes instantly and adjust panel opacity, blur, and brightness in settings. Create skins from local images or videos, then import or export skin packs. Requires Node.js 18.17+; ffmpeg is optional for media processing.

dsh-skin-kit README · 它能做什么：- **十套内置壁纸皮肤**，一张壁纸对应一套完整配色：云海星球、比奇堡晴日、白崖小径、冷峻次元、冰川河谷、暮色湖灯、海岸霓虹、海边书屋、富士夜色、晴空仰望。
- **换皮肤不用重启**。点一下卡片，界面立刻变。
- **三个滑杆实时调参**：主界面面板不透明度、壁纸模糊、壁纸亮度。点击「设置」打开的整个对话框固定为 70%，设置之外的主界面仍可自由调节。
- **自己的图片或视频一键变皮肤**。每次上传都会新增一张皮肤卡；mp4/webm 保留原始画质和帧率，ffmpeg 只负责取色，图片和其他视频格式才做必要优化。
- **调好的皮肤能打包分享**。导出一个 `.dshskin` 文件，配色、参数、壁纸都在里面，别人导入就是一模一样的效果。
- **体检和安全卸载**。DSH 有个坑：profile 里列了却解析不到的插件会让它**直接启动不了**。`doctor` 专治这个，包括别人留下的悬空依赖。

dsh-skin-kit README · 它怎么工作：```
dsh-skin-kit（一个包，三重身份）
├─ CLI            装/卸/体检/DIY/导入导出
├─ DSH host 半    /api/skin-kit/* 路由 + 配置读写 + 壁纸伺服
└─ DSH client 半  套用皮肤 + 「皮肤工坊」设置分区

三个值得说的设计：

**皮肤改的是设计令牌，不是类名。** DSH 前端所有颜色都读 `--dsw-*` CSS 变量，本工具覆盖其中全部 80 个。相比去命中 `.pI_x6G_frame` 这种构建期哈希类名，DSH 升级后不容易碎。

**壁纸走 HTTP 路由，不塞进 JS。** 用户上传的素材走 `/api/skin-kit/wallpaper/<id>`，文件在 `~/.dsh/skin-kit/wallpapers/`；随包默认壁纸走 `/api/skin-kit/asset/<skinId>`，文件在插件的 `skins/assets/`。这样不会把图片或视频膨胀进 `client.js`。

dsh-skin-kit README · 它怎么工作：**随包资产单文件上限 600KB。** `npm test` 会扫描 `skins/assets/`，任何文件超限都直接失败。原因不是浏览器加载不了，而是项目要保持 `npx github:` 首次拉取够快；十张图如果不设闸门，很容易把一个轻量插件拖成几十 MB。

**CSS 在浏览器里现算。** 皮肤编译器是纯函数，客户端自带一份，所以换皮肤和拖滑杆都不用等服务端往返。三个实时参数还进一步做成 CSS 变量（`--dsk-alpha` / `--dsk-blur` / `--dsk-brightness`），拖滑杆连样式表都不用重写，只改一个变量。

用户数据都在 `~/.dsh/skin-kit/` 下：`config.json`（当前皮肤和参数）、`skins/*.json`（自建皮肤）、`wallpapers/`（用户壁纸原文件）。十张默认壁纸随插件副本安装，不混进用户数据。
dsh-skin-kit README · 隐私与故障排查：所有图片、视频、取色和压缩都在本机完成，不会上传到 dsh-skin-kit 或哲风壁纸。遇到安装、profile、ffmpeg 或视频播放问题，请先看[故障排查](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。安全漏洞请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私密报告，不要直接贴到公开 Issue。

dsh-skin-kit README · What it does：- **Ten built-in wallpaper skins**, each pairing one packaged image with a complete UI palette.
- **Switching skins needs no restart.** Click a card, the UI changes.
- **Three live sliders**: main-UI panel opacity, wallpaper blur, wallpaper brightness. The entire Settings dialog stays fixed at 70%, while the UI outside Settings remains freely adjustable.
- **Turn your own image or video into a skin.** Every upload creates a new gallery card. mp4/webm keeps its original bytes, resolution, frame rate and colour; ffmpeg samples colours and only optimizes images or converts other video formats.
- **Share what you tuned.** Export a single `.dshskin` file carrying palette, parameters and wallpaper; whoever imports it gets exactly the same look.
- **Health check and clean uninstall.** DSH fails to boot when a profile lists a bundle it cannot resolve. `doctor` finds those — including dangling entries other tools left behind.

dsh-skin-kit README · Commands：| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `install [--profile <name>]` | Wire the plugin into a DSH profile |
| `uninstall [--purge]` | Remove it; `--purge` also deletes skins and wallpapers |
| `doctor [--fix]` | Check every profile for entries that break DSH boot |
| `list` | List skins and current state |
| `use <id\|none>` | Switch skin, or turn skinning off |
| `set alpha=.. blur=.. brightness=..` | Adjust parameters |
| `diy <image or video>` | Generate a skin from your own media |
| `export [id] [--out file]` | Write a `.dshskin` bundle |
| `import <file>` | Load a `.dshskin` bundle |

dsh-skin-kit README · Commands：Common flags: `--home <path>` (defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--json`.

dsh-skin-kit README · How it works：```
dsh-skin-kit (one package, three roles)
├─ CLI           install / uninstall / doctor / diy / export / import
├─ DSH host half /api/skin-kit/* routes, config storage, wallpaper serving
└─ DSH client    applies the skin, renders the Skin Workshop settings section

Three decisions worth calling out:

dsh-skin-kit README · How it works：**Skins override design tokens, not class names.** Every colour in the DSH frontend reads a `--dsw-*` CSS variable; this tool overrides all 80 of them. That survives DSH upgrades far better than targeting build-hashed class names like `.pI_x6G_frame`.

dsh-skin-kit README · How it works：**Wallpapers travel over HTTP, not inside the JS bundle.** User media is served from `/api/skin-kit/wallpaper/<id>` and stored under `~/.dsh/skin-kit/wallpapers/`; packaged defaults are served from `/api/skin-kit/asset/<skinId>` and live under `skins/assets/` in the plugin copy.

dsh-skin-kit README · How it works：**Each packaged asset is capped at 600 KB.** `npm test` fails when any file in `skins/assets/` crosses the limit. This keeps the first `npx github:` fetch fast instead of letting ten images turn a lightweight plugin into a multi-dozen-megabyte download.

dsh-skin-kit README · How it works：**CSS is compiled in the browser.** The skin compiler is a pure function shipped in the client bundle, so switching skins and dragging sliders never wait on a round trip. The three live parameters go one step further and become CSS variables (`--dsk-alpha` / `--dsk-blur` / `--dsk-brightness`), so a slider only changes one variable — the stylesheet is never rewritten.

dsh-skin-kit README · Privacy and troubleshooting：Images, videos, colour sampling and optimization stay on the local machine; they are not uploaded to dsh-skin-kit or 哲风壁纸. See [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for install, profile, ffmpeg and video issues. Report security vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-skin-kit README · Development：```sh
npm test        # 58 cases: compiler, profile wiring, HTTP routes, client DOM behaviour
npm run build   # regenerate lib/client.js after editing src/
```

`lib/client.js` is generated but **committed** — users install straight from the repository and never run a build. A test asserts it stays in sync with `src/`.

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history.
